title: Update on Review of Sports Hub Public-Private Partnership Arrangement
what_it_is: Update on Review of Sports Hub Public-Private Partnership Arrangement

sections.label: Sports Hub PPP performance monitoring
sections.summary: SHPL is contracted to design, build, finance and operate the Sports Hub, and SportSG monitors the operator's performance to meet project goals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Under the Sports Hub public-private partnership (PPP) arrangement, SportsHub Pte Ltd (SHPL) is contracted to design, build, finance and operate the Sports Hub.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Last month, over 100,000 fans attended the third edition of the International Champion's Cup at the National Stadium.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: However, like many Singaporeans, we have high expectations of the Sports Hub.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: There is room for improvement to make the Sports Hub the vibrant, integrated sports and lifestyle destination we envisioned.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Sport Singapore (SportSG) has been in regular communication with SHPL's senior management to monitor the performance of the operator, as well as to ensure that Singapore's goals and objectives of the project are met.

sections.label: Search for new CEO
sections.summary: A Member asks for an update on the search for a new CEO, noting an acting CEO is in place and that this is the Government's first major PPP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
sentences.text: Is it possible to share an update on the search for the new CEO, because without a CEO – I think with an acting CEO in place – it is obviously not ideal.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: This is the first major PPP that the Government has done and, obviously, we can all learn from the process.

sections.label: CEO continuity and management quality
sections.summary: The Government shares concerns about management continuity and quality, and the Chairman has relocated to take on the CEO role.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The issue on CEO, like the Member, we too, are very concerned about the continuity in management and also the quality of management.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: This is an area where we have regular discussions with the company and the shareholders as well.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: So, the Chairman has taken it upon himself to be relocated and to take on the CEO role.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: But continuity and high quality of management are areas of constant discussions between the Government and the company.
